text:
maria_ops: Heads up — AtlasGrid just sent a shipping variance. Two weeks later than our reserved window for Q3 GPU pool. Need routing playbook ASAP.

ops-bot: capacity-alert: partner=AtlasGrid reservations=[RES-87431, RES-87432] eta_delta=+14d

tom_partnerships: Ugh. Which customers are impacted by those reservations?

maria_ops: RES-87431 -> 4 dedicated customers (high SLAs), RES-87432 -> 2 startups on trial. I'll paste IDs: 
```
RES-87431: cust-A, cust-B, cust-C, cust-D
RES-87432: cust-X, cust-Y
```

alex_logistics: Confirmed. AtlasGrid says airfreight capacity is clogged for APAC, can still expedite to US west if we accept extra transit cost.

sunil_sales: For the four dedicated customers, we promised monthly commit deliveries in contract. We need options: refund/credits, temporary bursts from marketplace, or swap regions.

jenna_pm: Can we fall back to our marketplace partners for burst capacity while AtlasGrid sorts it? Any slot availability?

kyle_eng: From infra side, swapping regions is non-trivial for pinned Dedicated pools. But we can spin up temporary capacity on the hosted pool and route traffic at the load-balancer layer for up to 72 hours. Requires config changes and routing policy update.

tom_partnerships: Let's build a short playbook so ops/sales know the steps. Draft idea: 1) Notify affected customers with ETA + mitigation options; 2) Offer hosted-burst + credits for dedicated customers; 3) If they require region pin, propose phased migration and one-time discount; 4) For trials, offer free credits + delayed commit. Thoughts?

maria_ops: Love it. Add step 0: try to get AtlasGrid to re-route two racks to our US freight lane (we cover extra freight). They might do partial split.

alex_logistics: I'll ask AtlasGrid for a manifest split today. ETA on response ~6h. If they accept, we can avoid marketplace spend.

sunil_sales: I'll draft customer comms for the dedicated accounts with the 3 mitigation options. Need templates.

jenna_pm: I'll own the playbook doc. Tom/Maria can review. Include decision matrix: impact level vs recommended action (marketplace burst / accept delay / region swap).

kyle_eng: Technical checklist for hosted-burst: update routing policy, enable model-variant fallback (quantized 4-bit), set token rate limits, and add KV cache warming. I can prepare a runbook snippet.

maria_ops: Good — also record cost delta so finance can sign off on credits. Alex, ask AtlasGrid if they can provide partial invoices for extra freight.

alex_logistics: On it. Also flagging: RES-87431 has a hardware SKU mismatch on one rack (32GB -> 16GB mislabel). AtlasGrid is verifying. That could force more customers into lower perf variants.

tom_partnerships: Yikes. If that's true, include an explicit customer-facing note about possible perf variance and provide options to downgrade model or accept temporary latency bump.

sunil_sales: I'll coordinate with cust-A & cust-B PMs. If they're enterprise, they'll want SLA credits vs temporary hosted-burst. We'll push for hosted-burst + pro-rated credit.

jenna_pm: Drafting playbook now. Rough TOC: Incident summary; Impact matrix; Mitigation options; Communication templates; Technical runbooks (kyle); Logistics actions (alex); Approvals & finance flow.

maria_ops: Who signs off on using marketplace capacity (cost center)? ops or sales?

sunil_sales: Sales cannot approve platform spend alone. Ops to approve emergency marketplace spend up to $25k; above that need finance/EM.

maria_ops: Noted. We'll prepare a short approval packet if cost >25k.

ops-bot: deploy-note: created doc /playbooks/atlasgrid-routing-playbook-draft by jenna_pm

tom_partnerships: Next steps: Alex ping AtlasGrid for manifest split + SKU verification; Maria confirm impacted customers and severity; Jenna post draft; Kyle prepare runbook snippet; Sunil prepare comm templates and pre-approve credits up to 25k. We'll reconvene in 4 hours.

maria_ops: Added: tag @legal if contracts need emergency amendment for freight cost.

alex_logistics: Update 2h later -> AtlasGrid responded: willing to split manifest (2 racks to US) but the SKU mismatch is real on 1 rack; replacement ETA 3 weeks. They offered $8k freight credit if we accept split.

sunil_sales: Based on that, offer to dedicated customers: immediate hosted-burst + $8k shared credit applied to those accounts, and schedule replacement in 3 weeks. I'll tailor per customer.

jenna_pm: Draft posted: /playbooks/atlasgrid-routing-playbook-draft (links in console). Please review.

kyle_eng: Reviewed runbook. One note: enabling model-variant fallback requires a quick canary config to avoid KV cache thrash. Add that step.

maria_ops: Thanks all. Final ask: Tom, can you own the partner negotiation to get AtlasGrid to prioritize replacement racks?

tom_partnerships: On it. I'll escalate to their account director and ask for priority replacement and an SLA-penalty clause for the 3-week window.

maria_ops: Great. We'll call it out in the playbook and send the first comms after legal ok on freight amendment.

ops-bot: thread-closed: no further action pending durable commitments
